title: Unraveling the therapeutic mechanisms of Polygonum cuspidatum in pulmonary fibrosis: Modulation of M2 macrophage polarization and glycolysis pathways.
authors: Gao, Yini; Ng, Chester Yan Jie; Ni, Kaiwen; Hu, Qiangzhi; Shi, Xiawei; Si, Tianyu; Zhang, Xinxin; Yang, Jia; Yang, Junchao; Xu, Tingzhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虎杖通过HIF-1alpha/STAT3通路调节M2巨噬细胞极化和糖酵解治疗肺纤维化，仅用分子对接预测化合物与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Polygonum cuspidatum (PC), a plant widely distributed in East Asia, is traditionally used for respiratory diseases and is documented in the "Compendium of Materia Medica" as having heat-clearing properties. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic effects, molecular targets, and mechanisms of PC in mediating Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A bleomycin-induced IPF mouse model was established. Histopathological examination, hydroxyproline quantification, and extracellular matrix (ECM) marker analysis evaluated PC's anti-fibrotic effects in vivo. Macrophage infiltration and polarization were assessed using qRT-PCR, western blotting, and immunohistochemistry. Network pharmacology identified PC-modulated IPF pathways, and molecular docking assessed interactions with predicted molecular targets. Pathway effects on PC were verified through qRT-PCR, immunoblotting, and immunofluorescence. A co-culture model involving M2-polarized macrophages and MRC-5 fibroblasts further validated PC's antifibrotic activity. RESULTS: PC lowered hydroxyproline levels, preserved lung structure, and reduced E-cadherin, alpha-SMA, and fibronectin expression. PC inhibited M2 macrophage infiltration in vivo and suppressed M2 markers (CD206, Arginase1) and Spp1. Network pharmacology identified HIF-1 signaling as a core pathway, supported by strong binding affinity between PC compounds and HIF-1alpha. In vitro and in vivo studies showed that PC suppressed IL-4- and IL-13-induced activation of the HIF-1alpha/STAT3 signaling pathway in M2 macrophages. By reducing glycolytic enzymes (HK2, GLUT1, PFKFB3, LDHA), PC attenuated HIF-1alpha-dependent glycolysis and improved myofibroblast activation in MRC-5 cells. CONCLUSION: PC exerted anti-fibrotic effects by targeting the HIF-1alpha/STAT3 pathway in macrophages, suppressing M2 polarization and associated glycolytic programming, disrupting the feedback loop between macrophages and fibroblasts.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：虎杖（Polygonum cuspidatum, PC）是一种广泛分布于东亚的植物，传统上用于治疗呼吸系统疾病，并在《本草纲目》中记载具有清热功效。研究目的：本研究旨在评估PC在介导特发性肺纤维化（Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, IPF）中的治疗效果、分子靶点及作用机制。材料与方法：建立博来霉素诱导的IPF小鼠模型。通过组织病理学检查、羟脯氨酸定量及细胞外基质（extracellular matrix, ECM）标志物分析，评估PC在体内的抗纤维化作用。使用qRT-PCR、western blotting和免疫组织化学评估巨噬细胞浸润和极化。网络药理学鉴定了PC调节的IPF通路，分子对接评估了与预测分子靶点的相互作用。通过qRT-PCR、免疫印迹和免疫荧光验证通路对PC的影响。涉及M2极化巨噬细胞和MRC-5成纤维细胞的共培养模型进一步验证了PC的抗纤维化活性。结果：PC降低了羟脯氨酸水平，保护了肺结构，并减少了E-钙黏蛋白、α-SMA和纤连蛋白的表达。PC在体内抑制了M2巨噬细胞浸润，并抑制了M2标志物（CD206、Arginase1）和Spp1。网络药理学将HIF-1信号通路确定为核心通路，PC化合物与HIF-1α之间具有强结合亲和力支持了这一点。体外和体内研究表明，PC抑制了IL-4和IL-13诱导的M2巨噬细胞中HIF-1α/STAT3信号通路的激活。通过减少糖酵解酶（HK2、GLUT1、PFKFB3、LDHA），PC减弱了HIF-1α依赖性糖酵解，并改善了MRC-5细胞中的肌成纤维细胞活化。结论：PC通过靶向巨噬细胞中的HIF-1α/STAT3通路，抑制M2极化和相关糖酵解编程，破坏巨噬细胞与成纤维细胞之间的反馈回路，从而发挥抗纤维化作用。
